label: The divergent pivot fires only at a STOP candidate (composite_converged or all_questions_answered) and only sets next_focus to one Council-selected candidate; it writes no registry question, so the stop denominator is unchanged.
The pivot is bounded to maxPivots 3, maxCouncilSeatOutputs 9, invariants rounds 1 / seats 3 / depth 1 / recursionAllowed false, with a recursion guard.

Pivot candidates are seeded only from existing state (open and carried-forward questions, question conflicts, five state-record gap fields, CONTRADICTS edges, last 3 key findings); the code states the finding-verification seeds test existing findings rather than widen the topic.
Inference: on all_questions_answered each pivot buys about one verification-style iteration before the same STOP candidate recurs, at most 3 times.

Projection gap (inference): the pivot reads the gateway-refreshed state log, which drops graphEvents and other non-core fields, so the five state-record seed fields and CONTRADICTS edge seeds are likely never present; the agent record schema does not define those five fields.

The coverage graph is the only lever whose question set grows mid-run: agent-declared QUESTION nodes count in questionCoverage (covered needs >=2 answering findings, threshold 0.7) and can block STOP, but nothing routes graph questions into focus selection.
Sliding-window mode only substitutes a windowed graph novelty delta into novelty corroboration telemetry; it changes no focus, question or scope state.

Native fan-out widens across models, not scope: every research lineage gets the same research_topic, review lineages share one review_focus, and the merge deduplicates findings and open questions by id.
wave_orchestration is the only question-partitioned design and is excluded from workflow.steps (research YAML only); it prunes below median and boosts adjacent questions of a >2x outlier.

Deep-review scope is a fixed 4-dimension queue ordered once at init with a dimensionCoverage blocking guard at 0.8; no step discovers dimensions or sub-targets mid-run, and p0_override sits in the reference-only appendix.
No existing lever both discovers new scope and feeds it into focus selection and the stop denominator.
